steps.title: Check your own paragraph. Which of them did you do?
steps.model: Instructing: The first thing you do is… · Next,… · When you’ve done that,… · While…, … · Make sure you… · Finally,…

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use practical verbs — crack, rub, flip, deal with, turn up
✓ open a set of instructions — The first thing you do is…
✓ order the steps — Next… When you’ve done that… While… Finally…
✓ warn about the mistake before it happens — Make sure you…
✓ ask as a follower — How do you do that? Can you say that part again?
✓ write a paragraph that states an opinion, gives two reasons and one example
